name: Bauernheinrich
summary: Four-player shedding game where each player has a personal trump suit and Jacks are permanent top trumps.
rules_text: Use 32-card Skat pack. Jacks are permanent trumps ranking C,S,H,D above all other cards which rank A,K,Q,10,9,8,7. Deal 8 cards each concealed. Player with Ace of Clubs has Clubs as personal trump, next clockwise Spades, then Hearts, then Diamonds. Player with Ace of Clubs leads any card. Clockwise each player must if able beat the current top card by playing higher of same suit or by trumping with own trump suit or any Jack; Spades trump Clubs, Hearts trump Spades etc, but Jacks beat everything. If unable to beat, player must take all cards currently in the trick into hand. A trick holds up to number of active players. If the last player of a trick beats, the trick is discarded and that player leads next. First to empty hand wins first place; remaining continue with trick size reduced to number of players still in. Play until all placed.
